title: Variable Increment/Decrement
prompt:
Declare a variable and increment or decrement it using pre- or post-increment/decrement operators.
Sample Input: 10
Sample Output: 11, 9
answer:
Sure, I'd be happy to help with that! Here's a Python solution that demonstrates both pre-increment and pre-decrement operators (`++` and `--`), as well as post-increment and post-decrement operators (`++` and `--`).

```python
def increment_decrement(n):
    # Pre-increment (++)
    num = n
    print(f"{num}: {num + 1}")  # Output: 10: 11

    # Pre-decrement (--)
    num = n
    print(f"{num}: {num - 1}")  # Output: 10: 9

    # Post-increment (++)
    num = n
    print(f"{num}: {num + 1}")  # Output: 10: 11

    # Post-decrement (--)
    num = n
    print(f"{num}: {num - 1}")  # Output: 10: 9

# Call the function with sample input
increment_decrement(10)
```

This program declares a variable `num` with the initial value `n`, increments it using both pre-increment and post-increment operators, and then decrements it using both pre-decrement and post-decrement operators. The output will be:

```
10: 11
10: 9
10: 11
10: 9
```
